name: Reslice ROIs to match input DWI
summary: Reslices a collection of ROIs onto the voxel grid of a DWI image with FreeSurfer mri_vol2vol (header registration, nearest-neighbour interpolation).
description: Runs mri_vol2vol --regheader with nearest-neighbour interpolation on every ROI so that it matches the voxel size and grid of the DWI. Use it when ROIs were made on a different voxel grid (for example T1w resolution) but are already aligned to the DWI; it does not register the images. Needs a FreeSurfer license.

inputs.description: DWI image whose voxel grid is the target.
Collection of ROI NIfTI files already aligned (in world coordinates) to the DWI.

outputs.description: The ROIs resliced to the DWI voxel grid.

citations.text: Dale AM, Fischl B, Sereno MI. Cortical surface-based analysis. I. Segmentation and surface reconstruction. NeuroImage 9:179-194 (1999).
